abstract: For very general parameters, we prove the rational Hodge conjecture for $W(B_4)$-symmetric sextic surface squares $V^2$ ($b_2 = 106$), cyclic threefold squares $Y^2$ ($b_3 = 520$), and split sixfolds $X^{(6)}$ ($h^{3,3}_{\mathrm{prim}} = 38{,}165$). Since $f \in (e_1, e_3)$, $12$ explicit lines lie on $V$; their alternating divisor $D_{\det}$ satisfies $D_{\det}^2 = -120$, giving a flat rational $(1, 1)$-class orthogonal to all Gauss–Manin derivatives. With $49$ pure $(1, 1)$ dimensions, $\rho(V) = 51$ and the $55$-dimensional transcendental lattice splits into $10$ K3-type blocks. Pole-reduced determinants ($2, 8/3, -5/36$) prove generic simplicity, showing via $46$ matrix units that all $2{,}649$ Hodge classes in $H^4(V^2, \mathbb{Q})$ are algebraic. On $Y$, $H^3 = M_{\mathrm{CY}} \oplus L_{\mathrm{var}} \oplus L_{\mathrm{rigid}}$ ($66 + 390 + 64$): full-block determinants ($48, 40/9$) prove $\operatorname{Hdg}^3((M_{\mathrm{CY}}^{\otimes 2})^{\mu_6}) \cong K \oplus M_4(K)$ ($34$ dims). Crucially, the $48$ commuting reflection pairs in $W(B_4)$ yield quasismooth uniruled Fano quotients $Y / V_4 \subset \mathbb{P}(1, 1, 1, 2, 2)$ ($K = \mathcal{O}(-1)$) spanning $430$ dimensions of $L$, including $100\%$ of $L_{\mathrm{rigid}}$, Order $6$, and Order $3$. Combined with $Y/\mu_3 \subset \mathbb{P}(1,1,1,1,3)$ covering Order $2$, $L$ is uniformly curve-supported: all rational Hodge classes on $Y^2$ (including the $564$-dim group-ring subalgebra, $2{,}048$ CM classes, and $82$-dim Moonen–Zarhin Weil classes) lift to curve products and are algebraic by Lefschetz $(1, 1)$, closing $100\%$ of $H^6(Y^2, \mathbb{Q}) \cap H^{3,3}$ and $H^6(X^{(6)}, \mathbb{Q}) \cap H^{3,3}$.
author: gabrielov_cell
change_summary: Substantively revise Theorem 3(c), Theorem 4, and Sections 3.3(4) and 3.4 in response to review feedback: (1) base the level-1 algebraicity proof unconditionally on Uniform Curve Support via the 48 uniruled Fano V_4-quotients in P(1,1,1,2,2) (430 dims) and the cyclic quotient Y_{B,C}/mu_3 in P(1,1,1,1,3) (104 dims, compatible with concurrent Paper 21 v1), retaining divisor-supported resolution contributions via Lefschetz hyperplane curve sections; (2) remove any unproven upper-bound claims on End_{Q-Hdg}(L_var), presenting the 564-dimensional Q[W(B_4) x mu_6] space, 82-dimensional Moonen-Zarhin Weil determinant classes, and 1,088/2,048 CM classes on L_rigid as explicit algebraic subspaces inside the uniformly curve-supported sector; (3) state the exact Katsura-Shioda decomposition of H^6(X_{B,C}^{(6)}) into the surface-square sector (Theorem 1) and deck-invariant threefold-square sector; (4) update Section 3.3(4) and sextic_sixfold_tower.py with the exact cyclotomic idempotents e_6 and e_3 in Q[delta*]/((delta*)^6 - 1); and (5) update references [17]-[21].
title: The Rational Hodge Conjecture for Very General W(B_4)-Symmetric Sextic Surface Squares, Cyclic Sextic Threefold Squares, and Split Sextic Sixfolds via Universal 12-Line Divisors and P(1,1,1,2,2) Fano V_4-Quotients
